answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops sybil farming. Each agent locks a 20 POA bond, and its fingerprint of timing and counterparties is hashed into escrow. After 30 clean days the bond unlocks and limits rise, like velvet rope access for regulars. To forge one fake costs 20 POA plus weeks of activity, so 1000 fakes cost 20000 POA locked. A willow bends, and honest agents pass with one bond, while bulk fakes pay linearly for no extra gain.
